intentionally_varied_factor.bounded_residual_difference: Marker lexical/semantic novelty remains. Exact n-gram repetition, 34-token periodicity, and aligned 16-token block duplication move together under this intervention and are not individually isolated.
intentionally_varied_factor.description: Replace B's single repeated neutral marker with 24 reviewed neutral markers while retaining the exact B sentence template and the complete cumulative prompt-token count profile.

interpretation_contract.anchor_validity_rule: B must reproduce the governed historical 0_OF_3 exact-object outcome before D receives mechanistic interpretation.
interpretation_contract.mixed_result_rule: Any 1_OF_3 or 2_OF_3 primary-endpoint result receives no mechanistic claim.

outcomes.bounded_interpretation: Marker-only diversification substantially reduces exact token/block repetition and restores the endpoint while the complete B cumulative prompt-token trajectory remains fixed. This strengthens a repetition-sensitive representation mechanism and weakens the token-length trajectory alone as an explanation. It does not separate n-gram repetition, aligned-block recurrence, or marker novelty.

The reviewed marker-only diversification is insufficient to restore the endpoint. Combined with the already-governed C success, a stronger diversification or threshold-like effect remains live, but no exact threshold is established.
The intervention is behaviorally unstable and receives no mechanistic claim.
The governed B failure anchor did not reproduce; D is not used for mechanistic inference.

purpose: Determine whether marker-only reduction of exact lexical/token repetition restores the exact-object endpoint while preserving the governed B cumulative prompt-token count trajectory, sentence template, total prompt length, role topology, runtime/model contract, and generation controls.
